statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or conduction abnormalities that may be precipitating these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion.
The diagnoses are R55 and G45.9.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The denial is based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before services were rendered.
